text:
Maya: quick sync — planning to enable canary for model v3.1 today. target is phased percent + region ramp. who can own monitoring?
Kevin: I can watch infra metrics for the first 30m. @Maya pls post exact rollout plan.
Maya: plan: start 5% in us-west only for 10m, if stable bump to 20% us-west + 5% eu-west, then add ap-southeast at 5% after further stability checks. rollback if p95 latency > 800ms or error rate > 1.5% for 5m.
Sree: add ML quality guardrail too — watch hallucination regression (eval set runs). threshold: >3% regression triggers rollback.
Julie: set me as the pager for customer-impact alerts during ramp. will be on-call.
Maya: feature flag name: `feature.model.v3_1.canary` with scope keys: region, percent. I'll create flag rules now.
Kevin: sample toggle via FF service: ```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"flag":"feature.model.v3_1.canary","region":"us-west","percent":5}'
```
Sree: nice. For the model routing we also need a fallback mapping to v3.0 if model load fails — confirm the runtime has fallback configured?
Maya: yes runtime fallback `model.route.fallback=v3.0` is set in canary policy. deploy-bot will log if fallback used.
deploy-bot: [INFO] scheduled canary enable for 2027-06-12T15:00:00Z by Maya — flag=feature.model.v3_1.canary, initial us-west=5%
ops-bot: alert rule created: infra.p95_latency > 800ms for 5m => notify #incidents + @Julie
Kevin: I'll watch infra dashboards (tokens/sec, p95, GPU mem) and post updates.
Sree: I'll kick off evals every 5m with the canary set (small eval harness). will post a short summary of prompt-level diffs.
Julie: ack, will be ready to rollback. what's the quick rollback command?
Maya: rollback CLI: ```bash
# disable canary entirely
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"flag":"feature.model.v3_1.canary","enabled":false}'
```
Maya: also manual console path: Console > Feature Flags > feature.model.v3_1.canary > Disable
Kevin: tiny request: add a 2xx success-rate check for lambda fanout path. saw flakiness earlier.
Sree: added that to the monitoring checklist.
Maya: schedule: now -> 5% us-west (10m), if ok -> 20% us-west + 5% eu-west (20m), then 5% ap-southeast (20m). final go/no-go at ~1.5h.
Julie: thumbs up. tagging @product briefly: FYI this is the canary rollout for v3.1, no customer-visible changes unless we promote.
Maya: thanks — will post updates in this thread. please ping here if you see anything odd. :white_check_mark:
